newsitem.title: FRANCE: CYCLING-ZABEL CLOSES ON TOUR LEAD.
newsitem.headline: CYCLING-ZABEL CLOSES ON TOUR LEAD.

text.p: Italian Nicola Minali snatched a photo-finish win in the fourth stage of the Tour de France on Wednesday.
Minali edged out Frenchman Frederic Moncassin with Germany's Erik Zabel third after the 223 kms leg from Plumelec covered in five hours 46 minutes 42 seconds.
Zabel's placing, worth a deduction of eight seconds, cut back the overall lead of Italian Mario Cipollini to four seconds.
Cipollini and Zabel fought throughout the stage for the time deductions at the three intermediate sprints with the German taking two seconds more than the Italian.
In the final charge, Cipollini finished fourth and out of the fight for a share of 30 seconds in deductions. But he still holds the leader's yellow jersey for a fifth day.
